title: F97.3 tool search for the built-in tools
caption: A search of our own finds a tool the model can't see yet; each toolset keeps its few most-used tools loaded; a setting turns it on; a coding eval measures it before and after.

cards.title: Find a tool, don't send them all
cards.text: 98 tools, about 17,000 tokens, become a few loaded ones and a search; the rest are deferred on Anthropic.

cards.title: The proof first
cards.text: Thinking and the cache survive a found tool, or the plan stops.

cards.title: FindTool, in core
cards.text: Scores the chat's frozen tools by the query's words, best five.

cards.title: A strategy per provider
cards.text: defer_loading and tool_reference on Anthropic; the full list elsewhere.

cards.title: What stays loaded
cards.text: Each toolset names its most-used tools; the engine's own always stay.

cards.title: When it is on
cards.text: auto past ten deferrable tools; on and off for a test and the measure.

cards.title: Measured
cards.text: The coding agent's first eval, run before and after.
